title: The Job Interview
summary: Bright Path Travel needs a new customer assistant. Olivia, the hiring manager, wants to hear about you and your experience.
locked_summary: Bright Path Travel is looking for a new customer assistant.
npc_opening: Hello, thank you for coming in. Please, have a seat. To start, can you tell me a little about yourself?

objectives.description: Describe a job, a project or a responsibility you had in the past.
Explain why you want to work at Bright Path Travel.
